Class XmlIntervalTiersType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlIntervalTiersType
public class XmlIntervalTiersType extends Object
Interval tiers for the session.

Java class for intervalTiersType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="intervalTiersType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}recordIntervalTier" maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}intervalTier" maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="length" use="required" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}float" />
       <attribute name="unit" use="required" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}mediaUnitType" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getRecordIntervalTier

      public List<String> getRecordIntervalTier()
      Name of record tier. Inline media segments from the tier will be displayed in the view.Gets the value of the recordIntervalTier property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the recordIntervalTier property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getRecordIntervalTier().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list String
